Relabel Tree Tip Labels Using a Lookup Mapper

tree_relabel.Rd

Relabel Tree Tip Labels Using a Lookup Mapper

Usage

tree_relabel(tree, identifier = "sequence", mapper)

Arguments

tree

A tidytree treedata object.

identifier

Character. Mode for matching tip labels: "sequence" (default) maps tip labels directly via identifier to c_organism_label; "organism" matches voucher prefixes (^ZHH|^VPS) via c_organism_id to c_organism_label.

mapper

A data.frame lookup table containing mapping columns (identifier, c_organism_id, and c_organism_label).

Value

A tidytree treedata object with updated @phylo$tip.label.

Details

Duplicate labels in the resulting tip labels can cause C++-level errors when passed to ggtree::ggtree(). Deduplicate mapper (e.g., with dplyr::distinct()) beforehand if needed.

See also
